description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a black bog floor: black tar-like mud between tangled alder roots and dark moss tussocks, rotting twigs, muted very dark palette of black, deep green and dark brown, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
